publications.note: Reprinted as a paperback edition in 2018. The cover contains a photograph of Thomas Mann and one of Stefan Zweig. The cover was designed by Elmar Lixenfeld. The Thomas Mann photograph is located in the Thomas-Mann-Archiv, ETH-Bibliothek Zürich. The Stefan Zweig photograh is privately owned.
